rationale: Pursuing area/resource relief. The total execution time is extremely short at 63 cycles (with 34 memory cycles), indicating that large buffers and caches are drastically over-provisioned. Shrinking CONFIG_ACC_CACHES from 512 to 256 sets and reducing CONFIG_QUEUE_SIZE from 4 to 2 targets the relatively high LUT (43.98%) and BRAM (18.2%) utilization, which should improve the resource score without impacting latency.
search_intent: Shrink accelerator caches and queue size to relieve area and resource pressure.
